Exact telescoping proves basin probabilities; arctanh series and even-grid cutoff prove rate floor and power-law constant. Executed standalone checker independently validates finite sample algebra, not the universal theorem.

value.rationale: A natural source example with infinitely many coexisting stable cycles does not itself determine where initial conditions settle or how their stability is distributed in original physical time. The theorem gives a complete local basin partition, an exact probability tail for uniform section sampling, and a nontrivial change in almost-neutral stability distribution with oscillation order; these are motivated natural invariants rather than arbitrary narrow numerics.
